title: Memory as Typed Records
description: Pydantic MemoryRecord validates each remembered fact with key, value, and source for provenance; saves to JSON and refuses corrupt files.

steps.description: Purpose: P6 validates agent memory as typed records.
MemoryRecord: Pydantic model with key, value, and source fields for provenance tracking.
Setup: MEMORY file path and TypeAdapter for list validation.
Save: writes validated records to JSON file with indentation.
Load: reads and validates JSON, handles missing file or corruption gracefully.
Demonstration: creates clean records, saves, reloads, damages file, and shows refusal.
